summary: Observed meeting between Alexei Volkov and Klaus Richter. Discussion focused on 'dual-use' technology transfer agreements.
Dr. Aris Thorne and Dr. Evelyn Reed co-published a paper on advanced gene-editing techniques. The research was funded by a grant from 'RD Innovations', a subsidiary of Richter Dynamics.
Anomalous cargo shipment logged by Sea Serpent Logistics. Cargo manifest was falsified. Marcus Vance oversaw the operation.
Jamal Al-Fayed facilitated a multi-million dollar transfer through Finanz Stability AG. Funds were traced to an account linked to Victor Orlov.
Isabella Cruz published her expose on Sea Serpent Logistics, citing an anonymous source from within the company's European operations.
A sophisticated cyberattack, attributed to the 'Black September' hacktivist group, targeted a European aerospace firm. Elena Petrova is the primary suspect.
Aethelred Industries and Richter Dynamics announced a joint venture for advanced materials research. Chen Lin and Freja Eriksen are leading their respective teams.
Undercover agent Ben Carter reported a meeting between Marcus Vance and known fixer Liam O'Connell, discussing 'specialized transport' services.
Yuki Tanaka's lab demonstrated a new autonomous drone prototype. The project was funded by a grant from a foundation controlled by Klaus Richter.
Maria Flores, a cartel lawyer, was observed in a meeting with representatives from Sea Serpent Logistics. The topic is believed to be narcotics trafficking routes.
An illegal arms shipment containing European drone components was intercepted. The transaction was linked to dealer Samir Khan and financed through an account tied to Victor Orlov.

Cultural attaché Eva Rostova, a former GRU colleague of Alexei Volkov, held a discreet meeting with an unidentified German national. Surveillance suggests it was Laura Brandt, CFO of Richter Dynamics.
